bluf: Digitas is Publicis Groupe's Boston based networked experience agency (founded 1980), selling creative, media, CRM and loyalty, social and commerce practices to enterprise brands behind a proprietary stack from Digitas AI to Media OS. The record shows no dated move beyond an undated sonic identity, no news, no jobs, no pricing, and a sitemap of 1387 URLs with 0 updated in 90 days. Horus reads it Neutral at minus 3.9; Monsoon reads Breeze at 41.1. doing:
The positioning line, "The Networked Experience Agency: creative, media, CRM and loyalty, social and commerce practices built for brands in people's personal networks," decodes to a full service holdco unit that sells its practices as one, on the argument that brands now live inside people's personal networks. The headline claim, that it is "named a Leader by Forrester and Gartner in global marketing" and a Forrester Wave Loyalty Services Leader for Q2 2024, is quoted as a claim.

The sold mix has no lead line: AI Automation / Agents, Email & CRM, Paid Social, Programmatic & CTV and Retail Media each score 2 and none scores 3. Digitas AI builds brand safe AI agents through its Agent Management System; the CRM & Loyalty practice runs on Salesforce and Epsilon platforms; the Social Transformation practice covers paid social activation, community and social commerce; the Networked Media practice carries DSF real time buy optimization and Media OS on Epsilon CoreID data; the Total Commerce practice sells retail media activation and digital shelf work with Profitero and Epsilon Retail Media. Partners listed: Adobe, TikTok, Salesforce, Epsilon and Profitero. Proprietary lines: Digitas AI, Digitas Go for on demand creative production, DSF, Media OS, SWAT, the NX Score AI brand connection index and Digitas Pictures, the branded content studio. SEO, Paid Search, AI Search / GEO, CRO and Local all score 0.

Its AI posture is a proprietary agent operating system, Digitas AI, for creative testing, persona agents and generated web content, plus the NX Score index; it sells no AI search visibility line.

The only move on record is a new sonic identity, undated, seen as a site ticker in the September 2026 crawl. No news, case study list, job posting or pricing model is recorded. Absent for a holdco digital unit: any search line, a measurement line above 1, and any dated activity in 2026 beyond the ticker.
clients:
The ICP is enterprise; the verticals on record are beauty retail, convenience retail, consumer health, food and nutrition, education technology and mass retail; the home market is the US, with Boston the only office listed.

The record names 7 clients, 5 through case study pages and 2 through slugs, and codes 2 as observed and 5 as N0, engagement named only. The observed pair: ABCmouse came for brand and creative, the signal being the case slug old school brand new school (N3), and Atkins for web build and platform, the slug recipe serving website evolution (N4). Sephora (get beauty people who get beauty), RaceTrac (some cravings have their own gravity), Haleon (target audiences not created built), Walmart (walmart carts) and Crocs (kid crocs) are names with a case title and no described need; the capability notes tag the Sephora and Haleon cases to Networked Media, so their inferred need is paid performance, said as an inference, and the rest is inferred from the sold mix of paid social, programmatic and retail media.

The shared count is 3: Sephora sits on the pmg and honcho books, Atkins on rise-interactive and Walmart on publicis-sapient.

What the base needs next, tied to the edition: KJ4 (the platforms are absorbing the execution layer) is the read's best placement, driven by Data & Measurement and Retail Media, so these retail and consumer health brands will likely buy the inputs automation runs on, first party data and creative volume, which the record says it supplies (P4 making). KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) is its largest headwind, net 0.585 against, so it is likely, at moderate confidence, that the same clients test output priced alternatives to its paid social and content hours, which the record's silence on pricing cannot answer.

openings:
The strongest opening is the thin book: 5 of 7 clients on record are names with a case title and no described work, Sephora already sits on the pmg and honcho books, and Atkins and Walmart on rise-interactive and publicis-sapient, so a rival with described, measured retail media or loyalty work is likely to get a hearing at a beauty or mass retail buyer (moderate confidence). The falsifier: a refreshed digitas.com work section that describes outcomes for those accounts at the next compile.

Second, KJ6: the sold mix leans on paid social and content hours the judgment removes, net 0.585 against, and with no public pricing model (P5 unknown) an outcome priced offer meets no public answer; a holdco buyer likely asks that question first.

Third, the idle house: 1387 sitemap URLs with 0 updated in 90 or 365 days, no llms.txt, no Google ads and 3 LinkedIn ads that recruit rather than sell, so a rival can very likely out publish it on the AI and commerce topics it claims (high confidence). A pure price attack is unlikely to land: displacement reads 33.6 and the ICP is enterprise, so lead with proof and published work, not rate.
